title: 第3章 入学面试第4章 其实只是个炮灰
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
马车的内部装饰果然也如法伦所料地采用了深紫色调。
整个车厢内仿佛笼罩在神秘中，让人不禁想到占卜师。
车内没有窗户，但弥漫着的香薰却营造出一种特殊的氛围，仿佛能让人沉浸其中，忘却外界的喧嚣和纷扰。
而在车门的内侧，悬挂着一颗犹如夜明珠般的物品。
它散发着微弱的光芒，给人一种宁静而祥和的感觉。
这颗珠子或许有着某种神奇的力量，又或者只是单纯的装饰品，但无论如何，它都为这辆马车增添了一份独特的魅力。
此时的法伦显得有些心不在焉，不知是被突然的面试吓到了，还是因为正在和18+游戏的角色共处一室。
“你放轻松一点也没关系，说是面试，其实只是聊聊天。”
软糯的声音仿佛要把法伦的骨子都给酥麻了，“需要喝点什么吗？”
法伦的正对面是一位看上去不到三十岁的银发女子，她的肌肤白皙如雪，微微上扬的嘴唇带着一丝难以察觉的笑容，深黄色的眼眸如同包含了星辰一般，深邃而神秘，让人不由自主地陷入其中。
她身穿一件深紫色的长袍，袍袖宽松，袖口处绣着精致的花纹。
长袍的材质轻薄如纱，透过布料可以隐约看到她里面穿着的亵衣。
此刻的她正以一种夸张的姿态斜靠在座椅上，一只手轻轻放在扶手上，另一只手则拿着酒杯，慢慢摇晃着，红酒在杯中晃动，散发出诱人的香气。
她的坐姿优雅而慵懒，丝毫不像一个老师。
【应该说果然不愧是18+游戏里面的角色吗？而且还是个有立绘的重要NPC。
果然我是穿越到了一个和那个游戏几乎一模一样的世界里了。
】表面上心不在焉的法伦内心却在狂喜，除了那不知道有啥用的金手指以外，自己还有其他凭仗。
“我想我大概是不能喝酒的。”
虽然是异世界，但比如未成年人不能喝酒这种法律也是存在的。
“抱歉，是我考虑不周到了。

虽说并不正式，但这也算是一个小面试吧。”
她另一只手打了个响指，手中的酒杯便不翼而飞了。
【真是神奇。
】法伦感叹道。
“先做个自我介绍吧，我是阿瓦隆学院的心理老师，伊莎贝拉?曼斯菲尔德。”
伊莎贝拉依旧保持着斜靠的姿势，似乎没有要坐起来的打算。
【果然也是叫伊莎贝拉，但是后面的姓氏倒是游戏里面没有。
伊莎贝拉是游戏里最出名的几个NPC之一，除了高质量的立绘以外，她在游戏里还可以花费学分提升主角的表达能力，让主角的一些行为可以提高女性角色更多的好感度。
她的任务奖励也大都是提升角色好感度的物品。
所以很多玩家会戏称她为红娘或者月老。
法伦从口袋里摸出那张车票，双手递到伊莎贝拉面前，“我叫法伦?特里斯，出身于拉纳港。
这是我的车票。”
伊莎贝拉接过车票，有些惊讶地说道：“居然是从索提斯海港上车，那几乎是横跨了整个帝国。
对一个15岁的少年来说，还真是了不起。”
content_en:
The interior decoration of the carriage was indeed as dark purple as Fallon expected.
The entire carriage seemed to be shrouded in mystery, making people think of a fortune teller.
There are no windows in the car, but the diffused aroma creates a special atmosphere, which seems to make people immersed in it and forget about the hustle and bustle of the outside world.
On the inside of the car door, there is an object like a night pearl hanging.
It emits a faint light and gives people a sense of tranquility and peace.
This bead may have some kind of magical power, or it may just be a simple decoration, but in any case, it adds a unique charm to the carriage.
At this time, Fallon seemed a little absent-minded. I don't know if he was frightened by the sudden interview, or because he was in the same room with the characters of the 18+ game.
"It doesn't matter if you take it easy. It's called an interview, but it's actually just a chat."
The soft voice seemed to numb Fallon's bones, "Do you need something to drink?"
Directly opposite Fallon was a silver-haired woman who looked less than thirty years old. Her skin was as white as snow, her slightly raised lips contained an imperceptible smile, and her dark yellow eyes seemed to contain stars. They were deep and mysterious, making people fall into them involuntarily.
She was wearing a dark purple robe with loose sleeves and delicate patterns embroidered on the cuffs.
The material of the robe is as thin as gauze, and the obscene clothes she is wearing underneath can be vaguely seen through the fabric.
At this moment, she was leaning on the seat in an exaggerated posture, with one hand gently placed on the armrest, and the other hand holding the wine glass, shaking it slowly. The red wine swayed in the glass, exuding an alluring aroma.
Her sitting posture is elegant and lazy, not like a teacher at all.
[Should I say that he is indeed a character in an 18+ game? And he is also an important NPC with a portrait.
Sure enough, I was transported to a world that was almost exactly the same as that game.
Fallon, who seemed absent-minded on the surface, was ecstatic in his heart. Apart from the golden finger of unknown use, he had other resources.
"I guess I can't drink."
Even though it's a different world, laws such as minors not being allowed to drink alcohol still exist.
"Sorry, I didn't think carefully.
Although it is not formal, it is still a small interview. "
She snapped her fingers with her other hand, and the wine glass disappeared from her hand.
【It’s amazing.
] Fallon sighed.
"Let me introduce myself first. I am the psychology teacher at Avalon College, Isabella Mansfield."
Isabella still maintained her reclining posture, and seemed to have no intention of sitting up.
[Sure enough, she is also called Isabella, but the last name after that is not in the game.
Isabella is one of the most famous NPCs in the game. In addition to high-quality vertical paintings, she can also spend credits in the game to improve the protagonist's expressive ability, so that some of the protagonist's actions can increase the favorability of female characters.
Most of her mission rewards are items that improve the character's favorability.
Therefore, many players will jokingly call her the matchmaker or Yue Lao.
Fallon took out the ticket from his pocket and handed it to Isabella with both hands, "My name is Fallon Tris, I was born in Lana Port.
This is my ticket. "
Isabella took the ticket and said with some surprise: "You actually got on the train from Sotis Seaport, which is almost across the entire empire.
For a 15-year-old boy, this is really amazing. "
